accounting.comparisons: Paired complete stream/task-family blocks; do not count correlated rows as independent trials. Report label/work/CPU versus exact correctness and accepted coverage. No scalar score may be tuned after reserved results.
required_components: Every successful and failed diagnostic probe with input/output processing
All synthesis work, failed candidates and errors
Program admission and state hashing/checkpoint preparation
accounting.source_access_log: All reserved specification fetches must be recorded after freeze; no hidden-target pilot before preregistration.
accounting.units: Label counts, charged deterministic work and measured process CPU reported separately. Probe work units are not human annotation time, dollars, energy or native CPUinstructions.

external.coverage: Report all354 universe tasks,183 metadata-eligible tasks,167 reserved eligible tasks, attempted tasks, unsupported tasks, abstentions and exact successes separately. Ineligible tasks are exclusions, not failures silently removed from headline coverage.

example_split.diagnostic_pool: First two original examples; inputs visible to every method; outputs buyer-only until selected by an explicit probe.
example_split.fixed4: Not a primary external comparator: asking4 would consume this protocol's scoring labels. Numeric fixed4 comparison is separate.
example_split.insufficient_examples: Count as unsupported/insufficient-data in the183 qualification denominator and354 external universe; never silently discard.
example_split.score: Every remaining original example, with exact original output strings; no zero-padding, duplicated fabricated samples or extension to24rows.

external.feedback: Commit proposal before buyer scores. Raw scoring labels never enter solver/controller; a source-bound aggregate accepted/rejected receipt may affect later tasks only, if identically available to all methods and explicitly counted. Freeze whether this prequential admission is used before execution.
external.initialization: Reserved primary may use one identical fixed2 DEV-admitted checkpoint for every method; its full private artifact hash, source_id and reproduction recipe must be frozen.
external.licensing: Default metadata-eligible group is entirely author-generated Synthetic:true and covered by CC-BY-SA-4.0. Eight source-derived tasks have other licenses and are not in this selected subset. Respect attribution/share-alike for any later redistributed derivative data; raw specs stay privately staged by default.
external.ordering: Original task example ordering; task ordering is lexical task_id, fixed before execution. No repeated folds, synthetic extra rows or success-based exclusions.
external.repeated_inputs: Preserve all original rows; report scoring rows overlapping diagnostic inputs and novel-input correctness separately. No duplicate row is described as novel held-out generalization.
external.state: One independent source-bound library per method. Initial state and admission policy must be frozen; no cross-method state or target sharing.

freeze_requirements: Freeze exact controller, language, solver, evaluator and independent verifier source SHA256 values in a new protocol before reserved specification access.
Freeze all stream generators, task ordering, source folds, limits and decision thresholds before reserved execution.
Preserve failed/unsupported/abstained tasks and complete denominator; publish source identities and metadata rather than a bulk benchmark corpus.
No performance claim is authorized by this draft or metadata inventory.

gates.benefit: Predeclare matched correctness/coverage and label-efficiency gates after development, before reserved targets; include all acquisition/probe/check costs.
gates.capability: A source-bound input-only request can select diagnostics, execute a retained program or acquire a new one, consume genuine buyer feedback and preserve state across restart.
failure: Unsupported/too-small examples shrink usable coverage and remain visible.
Wrong predictions, probe exhaustion and unresolved gaps must not be relabelled as successful abstention.
If fixed2/fixed4 or another strong conventional policy dominates, use that policy and retain the null result.
gates.novelty: The active policy is the strong conventional default, not evidence that Nuria beats that same policy. Any neural add-on requires its own same-information comparator.

numeric_development.ambiguity: Unlabeled input shape alone cannot determine arbitrary semantics or out-of-language targets. At least one audit label is the default; unresolved diagnostic ambiguity at the finite cap must abstain. Unanimity is only relative to the declared candidate set, not a proof of correctness on arbitrary inputs.
numeric_development.candidate_information: No format_index, recipe, source-row ID, skill_id, future outcomes or hidden branch labels enter routing. Inputs and acquired label receipts only.
numeric_development.diagnostic_pool: Same four original diagnostic input rows per file; only explicit probe actions release their labels.
numeric_development.fairness: All methods have identical grammar, retained-state capacity, solver, total tool budget, oracle access and input visibility. Fixed4 is the legacy behavior under the SAME synthesis budget, not a deliberately weaker solver. Random chooses probes uniformly over eligible unlabelled diagnostics. Frozen can solve and execute but cannot retain new verified programs.
numeric_development.final_rows: At least eight separate original source rows per file; raw labels withheld from every solver.
numeric_development.new_synthesis: Requires at least max(2, acquisition target, configured minimum evidence) DISTINCT labelled diagnostic inputs. Verified reuse has its own configurable audit minimum.
regimes: First encounter with unacquired supported composition
Declared semantic change with similar input shape
numeric_development.source: Existing pinned UCI Bike Sharing observations. Formatting and task streams are generated; prior project evaluations already used these observations, so do not call them globally unseen data.
numeric_development.status: Design pending final controller/source alignment; no reserved scores have been run for this draft.

purpose: Test input-only skill routing, selective diagnostic evidence, gap-triggered synthesis, and reuse after actual buyer verification. The active policy is conventional candidate elimination, not a neural-superiority claim.
